name: Montrose to Ouray Lateral
researcher_notes: EIA August 2026 natural gas pipeline projects workbook, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 329: Montrose/Ouray Lateral, completed 24 June 2004, operator listed as Rocky Mountain Pipeline Co, 58 miles, diameters 6 and 8 inches, 14 MMcf/d added, cost 20 million dollars, intrastate in Colorado. This is the only source for the line itself. No GEM row matches: the roster has no Rocky Mountain Natural Gas system and no Montrose or Ouray row. Black Hills Energy describes Rocky Mountain Natural Gas LLC as an intrastate system serving the western slope through Montrose, Ridgway and Ouray, which supports the owner but does not state this line's length or size; it also mentions 58 miles of 12 inch pipe, which conflicts with the EIA diameter and may be a different segment. The EIA operator name differs from the Black Hills name, so the owner match is inferred. Parent company not staged because it was not confirmed on a loaded page. Could be a distribution supply line, so check Colorado Public Utilities Commission records. 58 miles is about 93 km, above the 25 km rule. Route not researched: no official GIS found, so route is unavailable (no route). Intrastate, so no FERC filing is expected.
